## About

FourBridge Partners crafts selective portfolios of hard-to-access venture capital and growth equity funds. We pursue a long-term strategy focused on disciplined managers compounding long-term returns.

Our team draws on our expansive network, built over decades, to source, evaluate and partner with managers beyond the reach of most families and institutions.

FourBridge delivers diversified exposure to the fastest growing sectors in the economy with the concentration that preserves the exciting upside of venture capital.

### Our Values

#### Partnership

FourBridge acts as true partners – not intermediaries – fostering trust through transparency, aligned outcomes, and enduring vision. Every interaction compounds: the strength of our relationships shapes the strength of our results.

#### Discipline

FourBridge draws on decades of portfolio stewardship, market-cycle insight, and unwavering long-term focus. We remain deliberate amid volatility, prioritizing steady deployment through every phase.

#### Integrity

We honor commitments with candor, clarity, and respect. Safeguarding capital and reputation is paramount; both endure only through unyielding trust.

## Team

Our team brings decades of experience in private equity, operations, and value creation.

![Ted Clark](https://fourbridgepartners.com/_assets/v11/8c74cadc75123b685412458d7ffecdb194932039.png)

### Ted Clark

Co-Founder

Ted brings more than three decades of experience investing in venture capital and private equity funds. He has served institutional clients across the globe and has invested with many of the world's leading managers through his tenure at HarbourVest Partners, his role as Co-Founder, and Chairman of the Babson College Endowment Private Equity Committee.

[View Profile](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ted-clark-1a6b505/)

![Jon Terbell](https://fourbridgepartners.com/_assets/v11/e091ccc9b538f5259ae262ade9380de03340e3c0.png)

### Jon Terbell

Co-Founder

Jon began his institutional investing career at the Babson College Endowment. He has become a trusted voice in venture and growth-equity manager selection, helping shape portfolios for endowments, foundations and family offices.

[View Profile](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jon-terbell-6712aa16/)

![Chris Gilman](https://fourbridgepartners.com/_assets/v11/f5f2c3265fbe8a2a04a960f9242134db6c99330f.png)

### Chris Gilman

Operations Partner

Chris has served institutions and individuals on operations teams at leading outsourced investment offices and asset managers. Today, Chris is responsible for leading both firm and fund operations at FourBridge.

FEATURED INSIGHT

Podcast

## Venture Capital and Private Markets: A Conversation with Ted Clark and Jon Terbell

Bill Noble and Burke Koonce welcome Ted Clark and Jon Terbell of FourBridge Partners to discuss how private market investing works, the nuances of venture capital and how families and institutions can approach these opportunities strategically. With decades of experience managing private investments, including building the Babson College endowment's venture capital allocation, Ted and Jon share how FourBridge Partners identifies strong investment managers and builds long-term portfolios.
